title: Exact tensor preserves the recorded constant coefficient action after deriving
statement: For a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l, and a scheme Y in the same universe as E, let P be any module sheaf over the completed integral coefficient sheaf. Suppose the explicit right tensor functor with P is additive and preserves finite limits and finite colimits. Its exact derived functor is linear over the valuation ring of E for the published integralCoefficientLinear constant-section action on the ambient derived category. No local freeness, boundedness, constructibility or completeness assumption is needed.
